notes.subject: על צוארנו נרדפנו
notes.rationale: Baithuti ba fapana: 'ba ba re latedišago ba kgahlanetše le melala ya rena' (KJV, ASV) kgahlanong le 'go fihla go molala wa rena' (JPS, YLT).

notes.subject: לא הונח
notes.rationale: Nuhach: go phuma, go laologa — 'go šala sekgoba' o tšea sebopego sa go fologa; KJV 'rest' e nyenyefšitše ke 'no rest given' (passive).

translation: Fa godimo ga melala ya rena ba re dutše ba re latediša; re kgokile, go šala sekgoba go sa fologe go rena.

tokens.gloss: ba re dutše ba re latediša
